obligations.expected_behavior: During RED execution, classify a timeout as not being an expected RED result.
forbidden_result: A timeout is counted as expected RED.
obligations.observable_result: The RED outcome records the timeout as a non-expected-RED condition.
obligations.state_after: Timeout is excluded from expected RED classification.
obligations.subject: Timeout classification during RED execution
obligations.trigger: A timeout occurs during RED execution.

obligations.expected_behavior: Classify a zero-case test run as a harness failure.
forbidden_result: A zero-case test run is accepted as a valid RED result.
A zero-case test run is treated as an implementation result instead of a harness failure.
obligations.observable_result: The test run is reported with harness-failure classification.
obligations.state_after: The zero-case run is classified as harness failure.
obligations.state_before: A test run completes with zero cases.
obligations.subject: Zero-case test-run classification
obligations.trigger: A RED test run executes zero test cases.

obligations.expected_behavior: Do not authorize implementation based on repository noise.
forbidden_result: Repository noise is used as authorization to implement.
obligations.observable_result: Implementation authorization remains withheld when repository noise is the only signal.
obligations.state_after: Repository noise does not grant implementation authorization.
obligations.state_before: Repository noise is observed during RED execution.
obligations.subject: Repository-noise implementation gate
obligations.trigger: Repository noise is present during RED execution.

obligations.expected_behavior: Do not authorize implementation when the RED execution is unexpectedly green.
forbidden_result: An unexpected green result is used as authorization to implement.
obligations.observable_result: Implementation authorization remains withheld after an unexpected green result.
obligations.state_after: An unexpected green result does not grant implementation authorization.
obligations.state_before: RED execution produces an unexpected green result.
obligations.subject: Unexpected-green implementation gate
obligations.trigger: The RED execution is unexpectedly green.

obligations.expected_behavior: Stop another unchanged rerun when the deterministic failure fingerprint repeats identically for the second time.
forbidden_result: A second identical deterministic failure fingerprint triggers another unchanged rerun.
obligations.observable_result: The rerun loop stops immediately upon the second identical deterministic failure fingerprint.
obligations.state_after: No further unchanged rerun is started after the second identical deterministic failure fingerprint.
obligations.state_before: An unchanged rerun has already produced the same deterministic failure fingerprint once.
obligations.subject: Repeated deterministic failure rerun stop
obligations.trigger: The same deterministic failure fingerprint occurs identically for the second time.
